run.evaluation: 2000 held-out questions; same inputs and initialization for both arms

observations: This is one run per loss with seed 0, not enough to infer general superiority.
The dataset is synthetic and its soft labels are teacher-generated; these metrics do not establish real-world calibration.
Upstream emitted conflicting-schema warnings for action, urgency, and disposition; it kept the first definition encountered.
The RLCD arm emitted a warning that lr_scheduler.step() runs before optimizer.step(); the first scheduled learning-rate value may be skipped.
Both arms emitted a Transformers deprecation warning for gradient_checkpointing_enable.
